run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all state/territory portals (buy.nsw/tenders.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were swept via the WebSearch page-summariser for opportunities open or published/updated in the last 7 days. A Tier 2 sample covered local government (VendorPanel public tenders), water GBEs (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water), universities (Adelaide, and the health sector), and NSW transport authorities (Transport for NSW, Sydney Metro). The mandatory Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing check covered SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery and generic Coupa/Jaggaer/Felix corporate channels. As on every prior run, the environment's network egress proxy blocked WebFetch to every external tender domain tested (re-confirmed EGRESS_BLOCKED on www.tenders.gov.au this run; the proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, i.e. an organisation-wide egress policy), so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened directly and all data was gathered indirectly through the WebSearch summariser. Five open, buyer-corroborated opportunities were captured this run: Inner West Council RFT-43 Preferred Supplier Panel for Data/AI/Automation/Integration & Digital Solutions (EOI closing 30-Aug-2026, VendorPanel, public, good detail); Sydney Water RFI-2009090 Strategic Customer Engagement Program 2026-2029 (market sounding on buy.nsw, deliverables described, closing date not confirmable); Transport for NSW construction of the Macquarie Park Precinct & Bus Interchange (RFT closing 11-Sep-2026); Sydney Metro WSA Finalisation and Auxiliary Works (FAW) Corridor Restoration Works Seed Procurement (RFT closing 24-Aug-2026); and University of Adelaide RFP to Embed Sustainable Enterprise Delivery Capability for AU IT (active as of 20-Aug-2026, surfaced only via an aggregator, headline-level). One genuinely new buyer-originated source was discovered and recorded: the University of Adelaide / Adelaide University E-Tendering portal (illion TenderLink), noting the Jan-2026 amalgamation of UniSA and the University of Adelaide into 'Adelaide University'. Verification via search prevented false positives: the Transport for NSW Avoca Drive Upgrade EOI (closed 11-Aug-2026), a Queensland Health generic-pharmaceuticals RFQ (closed 18-Mar-2026) and a University of Adelaide Sustainability Reporting Assurance RFP (closed 29-Jul-2026) were all found already closed and excluded; and an unattributed Queensland 'Surgical Supplies' ITO (offers due 21-Aug-2026) again lacked a confirmable buyer identity/ID/URL and was not captured. The Commonwealth RASS Scheme ATM (PR10031930), captured on the 18-Aug run and still current, was not re-listed today (unchanged).
gaps: MAJOR CONSTRAINT (repeat of every prior run): the environment's network egress proxy blocked WebFetch to ALL external tender domains. Re-confirmed EGRESS_BLOCKED on www.tenders.gov.au this run; a direct curl CONNECT to the same host also returned proxy 403. The proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, toolScoped=false, i.e. an organisation-wide egress policy, so all state/GBE/corporate portals are assumed equally unreachable by direct fetch. Per the proxy README, policy denials are reported rather than routed around. Consequence: no detail page or specification document could be opened; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, document lists, exact dates and contacts could not be extracted directly for any opportunity this run and are limited to what the WebSearch summariser surfaced.

Because detail pages could not be opened, four of the five captured opportunities are headline-level or partially-detailed only: Sydney Water RFI-2009090 (deliverables described in search but no confirmable closing date, questions-due, contacts or document list); Transport for NSW Macquarie Park Precinct & Bus Interchange (closing 11-Sep-2026 corroborated but full scope, value, documents and contacts not readable); Sydney Metro WSA FAW Corridor Restoration Works Seed Procurement (closing 24-Aug-2026 corroborated but scope/value/documents not readable); University of Adelaide 'Embed Sustainable Enterprise Delivery Capability for AU IT' RFP (surfaced only via an aggregator index, no confirmable closing date, buyer-source URL detail, value or documents). All four are counted in entries_pending_detail and should be re-verified on a run with working egress or an authenticated portal session.

Opportunities surfaced by search but deliberately EXCLUDED as already closed or not confirmable (not listed as tenders): Transport for NSW 'Avoca Drive Upgrade' GC21 EOI (closing date 11-Aug-2026, already past); Queensland Health generic-pharmaceuticals supply-arrangement RFQ (closed 18-Mar-2026); University of Adelaide 'Sustainability Reporting Assurance Services' RFP (closed 29-Jul-2026); and an unattributed Queensland 'Surgical Supplies' ITO with offers due 21-Aug-2026 (no confirmable buyer identity, tender ID or buyer-source URL — the same item was flagged on the prior run and remains unattributable). Recorded here so future runs neither re-chase closed items nor attribute the surgical-supplies item irresponsibly.

Tier 1 VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT and ACT portals were confirmed live and enumerated, but their live open-opportunity lists could not be read directly under the egress block; only aggregator-surfaced snippets were available and no confirmed NEW open opportunity from those jurisdictions could be validated this run (deferred to a run with working egress).

AusTender: the Current ATM List and several current ATMs were visible in search result lists but could not be opened to confirm scope or dates, e.g. ATM_2026_6026, RFI_ATM_2026_6026, ATM_2026_3048, and the 'ASCA EDT P2ISR RFP'. Deferred rather than captured at ID-only level or with guessed dates.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and generic Coupa/Jaggaer/Felix corporate channels were checked. All are registration- or invitation-gated with no publicly visible individual opportunity this run; recorded only as discovered_sources on prior runs, never fabricated as tenders. No publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible this run.

The Commonwealth notice of the AusTender Supplier Portal opening to all businesses from 1 July 2026 was re-surfaced; the relevant portals ('Australian Government Supplier Portal' / 'AusTender GovPanels / Supplier Portal') are already in the known-source set, so it is not recorded as a new source.
recommended_seed_additions: University of Adelaide / Adelaide University E-Tendering (illion TenderLink) - portal.tenderlink.com/adelaideuni and portal.tenderlink.com/adelaideuniversity - the university runs its own e-tendering portal separate from Tenders SA; note the Jan-2026 amalgamation of the University of South Australia and the University of Adelaide into 'Adelaide University', which is changing how suppliers engage from 1 Jan 2026. Worth monitoring weekly alongside Tenders SA.

tenders.title: Strategic Customer Engagement Program 2026-2029 (Request for Information)
tenders.description: Sydney Water is seeking information on market capability, experience and available solutions to inform the procurement strategy for its next Strategic Customer Engagement program covering 2026-2029.
tenders.deliverables_summary: A market sounding to gather intelligence for a future Strategic Customer Engagement program. Respondents describe their capability to deliver customer engagement (including deliberative processes), customer research (online surveys, focus groups, forums, in-depth interviews, willingness-to-pay/choice modelling), economics and regulatory advisory input, and diverse and inclusive engagement (First Nations, CALD communities, financially vulnerable groups and people with disabilities). The buyer's objective is to demonstrate that its decision-making, planning and business practices are shaped by and responsive to its diverse customers, stakeholders and community.
key_deliverables: Customer research (surveys, focus groups, forums, in-depth interviews, willingness-to-pay/choice modelling)
Diverse and inclusive engagement (First Nations, CALD, financially vulnerable, people with disabilities)
tenders.contract_term: Program period 2026-2029 (subsequent procurement, if any, to follow the RFI)
tenders.submission_method: Respond via the buy.nsw / NSW eTendering opportunity page
tenders.detail_source: WebSearch summary of buy.nsw opportunity RFI-2009090 (Sydney Water Corporation)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch for Sydney Water current tenders; the opportunity is buyer-originated, published by Sydney Water on the NSW Government buy.nsw portal.
tenders.notes: As an RFI/market sounding it precedes any tender. Deliverables summary is drawn from the search snippet of the buy.nsw page; the closing date, questions-due, contacts and document list could not be confirmed because the detail page could not be opened under the egress block. Counted in entries_pending_detail.
